summary: The tutorial covers how to use various view options in LibreOffice Impress, a presentation software. It starts with opening sample presentations on GNU Linux using LibreOffice Impress version 334. Key views discussed include Normal View, Outline View, Slide Sorter, and Notes View. Normal View shows slides in a default layout, while Outline View displays slide contents hierarchically. Slide Sorter allows reordering slides, and Notes View provides space for presenter notes. The tutorial also explains how to customize slide designs through the Master Pages section, which includes predefined design templates. Users can apply these designs to slides and rearrange them as needed. Additionally, it demonstrates changing the layout of slides by selecting different options in the Layout section. The overall lesson emphasizes mastering view options and utilizing Master Pages to create a professional presentation with a dark blue background and light blue title areas.
